registered_addition_groups.rationale: Detached preflight construction only. Findings are canonical SHA-256 encoding and local set-based uniqueness/coverage checks over already-declared source-binding metadata. The module imports no filesystem, network, scheduler, persistence, capture, expression, or action-execution surface and cannot create retained observations, mutate the registry owner, start a window, authorize cutover, or open M3-E authority.

Audit CLI only. Findings are deterministic report hashing, local error-list/report-map bookkeeping, sys.path setup, and caller-requested stdout/file report output. Filesystem checks only verify that the two named future production component paths are absent. The audit installs no capture, retains no observation, touches no runtime owner/persistence state, starts no observation window, and grants no authority.

Surviving PR #186 focused-test registration after PR #187 updates the readiness assertions. The remaining finding is local set construction for exact 37-axis coverage only; removed fingerprints no longer exist in the current tree and are intentionally retired rather than over-counted.
